outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official completed status for both modes is a failed solution: each evaluated 40 cases and passed 0, with an empty artifact directory and no final response. The concrete task-solving difference is process shape, not score: parallel spent active worker capacity on concurrent reverse-engineering reports and a planned audit whose workflow ended killed/null, while serial kept probing and prototyping in one actor. Neither run delivered the required /output/test7.rs, so the retained parallel pattern is adverse but not an outcome-differential explanation.
parallel_contributors: Four workflow children were allocated to recon/report work while implementation and validation remained unexecuted parent task items.
Workflow state ended killed/null with a stalled retry, an API-error child, and other children still in progress.
serial_contributors: Serial made local Rust prototype attempts and gdb probes in one actor but did not package a final /output deliverable before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial prototype work reached a partial offset model and cap investigation; parallel did not write an implementation artifact in the official output package.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported parallel adverse process contributor, not an exclusive root cause
